# `white_house_action_versions`

**White House action source versions**

One exact retained White House action-page version with source text, native category and literal dates. Related official-document facts may overlap; equivalence remains unresolved.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicitly selected nominations and appointments category pages and article HTML within a declared publication-date window. Changed HTML remains a separate version. This does not establish historical completeness or current legal effect. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Exact URL and HTML-digest matches reuse existing official routes. Similar titles and names never establish document identity. WordPress post IDs identify publisher posts, not nominations or people.

- **Parquet file:** `white_house_action_versions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `action_version_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic identity of one exact White House URL and original HTML digest; not a legal-action identifier. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact publisher article URL validated against its canonical link. |
| `native_post_id` | `VARCHAR` | WordPress post identifier explicitly stated by the selected category listing. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | White House headline, decoded from its original HTML. |
| `document_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal White House article subcategory; not inferred from its title. |
| `categories_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered category labels from the retained category listing; article type remains separate. |
| `listing_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact retained category-page URL supporting the selected URL cohort and post identity. |
| `listing_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained category-page HTML supporting this selection. |
| `listing_record_index` | `VARCHAR` | Zero-based article occurrence within the selected retained category page. |
| `published_time` | `VARCHAR` | Literal article:published_time value, including its source offset. |
| `display_time` | `VARCHAR` | Literal visible time datetime value; its instant must agree with published_time. |
| `modified_time` | `VARCHAR` | Literal article:modified_time value; NULL means absent and an empty string remains empty. |
| `modified_time_status` | `VARCHAR` | missing, empty or stated, according to the original modification-time field. |
| `body_text` | `VARCHAR` | Searchable text read from the article body without the title block or scripts; repeated source text remains repeated. |
| `body_html` | `VARCHAR` | Parser-serialized article body HTML, not byte-exact source HTML; source_sha256 identifies the exact original. |
| `body_selector` | `VARCHAR` | Selector and exclusions used to read body text from the retained original. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the complete retained original HTML response. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Observation time of this selected original response; unchanged refreshes keep the prior observation. |
| `parser_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the White House HTML reading rule. |
| `official_match_status` | `VARCHAR` | Always unresolved on every emitted row: related official facts may exist; no equivalent legal identity is asserted. Exact proven representation matches reuse the existing route instead of emitting a row. |
